_readme: Asset manifest. A null entry means 'not delivered yet': the game then uses its built-in placeholder. Add an entry only for a file that is in public/ and passes `npm test`. Inspect a candidate first: node scripts/inspect-png.mjs <file>.

anchor.rule: x: mean of the three grounded hoof centres; y: mean of their lowest rows

screenHeightPx.of: visible figure (visibleBBox.h), at the initial zoom

_entries.rider: character sprite: url, sha256, size, anchor {x,y} (ground contact), visibleBBox, screenHeightPx {desktop,narrow}, runtimeTextureSize
_entries.cargo: same fields as rider; drawn on each shipment, mirrored for westward travel
_entries.background: url, sha256, size [2560,1600] = world size; replaces the technical SVG, no baked labels, routes or characters
